acceptanceCriteria.text: Simulate lost response, reconnect, expiry and stale commands; assert same-command canonical retry, unchanged committed state and authoritative recovery.

A disconnect must not corrupt accepted scores or duplicate a submission. Reconnecting players retain membership for a two-minute grace interval; after it expires the room applies the normal departure rules. Client retries reuse the original command ID.

Room code, reconnect, creator departure: Use an eight-character Crockford Base32 code. Codes remain valid while the room is active and expire on close; empty rooms close after 30 minutes. Reconnect retains membership for a two-minute grace interval. Creator departure grants no special authority; remaining players retain control. Invalid/expired codes return the same generic not-found response; limit code attempts to 10 per minute per session.

## Boundaries

This documents the current matrix obligation, not a claim that all counts passed. Preserve the older 2 through 25 attempts with their original source and outcomes. The 29 October 15-player dirty-build pass is historical until the changed committed candidate is rerun. acceptanceCriteria.text: Actual private WebSocket subscriptions deliver only event/aggregate/version metadata to authenticated per-profile audiences; anonymous, cross-profile subscriptions and client publication are denied.

Repeatable browser integration creates real guests and room membership, enters a code, readies players, plays eight UI rounds, and verifies remote category, solve, hints, scores, reveal, reactions and final standings through actual private notifications and authorized reads while periodic UI polling is suppressed.

An authenticated server worker advances countdown and hint deadlines with all browsers offline, drains bounded durable outbox batches, reports deadline and publication failures separately, and preserves failed events for retry. Foreground requests never wait for an active worker batch.

The temporary HTTPS gateway serves app and Realtime paths while rejecting tenant management paths; private credentials and internal ports remain private. Cleanup acts only on its captured lease generation and owned resource identities. A separate-broker harness must own a separate strict-TLS game database/outbox; partial startup or unconfirmed cleanup preserves recovery identities and blocks replacement.

Focus, visibility and online recovery trigger authorized reads; concurrent reads coalesce one follow-up, older responses cannot lose newer notifications, and unmount/account changes prevent obsolete subscriptions after deferred authentication. Connected game/social safety reads use15seconds and disconnected recovery uses1second; cadence changes preserve in-flight/coalesced reads and independent display clocks. Presence responses are fully consumed before clearing canonical retries and refreshing; a body-read failure retains the exact retry command.
Real UI integration proves token renewal beyond the original120-second expiry and actual WebSocket close/reconnect followed by another push-driven game transition.

A disconnect must not corrupt accepted scores or duplicate a submission. Reconnecting players retain membership for a two-minute grace interval; after it expires the room applies the normal departure rules. Client retries reuse the original command ID.

Room code, reconnect, creator departure: Use an eight-character Crockford Base32 code. Codes remain valid while the room is active and expire on close; empty rooms close after 30 minutes. Reconnect retains membership for a two-minute grace interval. Creator departure grants no special authority; remaining players retain control. Invalid/expired codes return the same generic not-found response; limit code attempts to 10 per minute per session.
